note: Proposed wording (maintainer question Q1); not part of any identity.

wording.anchorAdvice: Share freezeSha256 with someone outside this computer, or commit it to a repository, before you measure or upload measurements. This app cannot prove the order of events by itself.
wording.banner: This is your test of the model on your data. It is not validation of this app, and the app's evidence labels do not change (experimentalValidation false).

blindness.blind-committed: Blind: your targets file was fixed by its hash before the predictions were frozen.
blindness.blind-prospective-declared: Blind as you declared: you froze the predictions before measuring.
blindness.blind-retrospective-declared: Blind as you declared: you measured before freezing, and no commitment of the targets was matched.
blindness.not-blind-app-history: Not blind: Build Job history on this computer holds these conditions before the freeze (partial check).
blindness.not-blind-data-already-used-by-app: Not blind: these data or conditions are in this app's spent ledger ({id}).
blindness.not-blind-earlier-test-overlap: Not blind: {k} conditions match a test on this computer that was revealed or scored earlier.
blindness.not-blind-predictions-revealed: Not blind: the frozen predictions were revealed before this score.
blindness.not-blind-predictions-viewed: Not blind: you declared that you viewed predictions for these conditions.
blindness.not-blind-rescored-changed-targets: Not blind: this attempt uses a targets file that differs from attempt 1.
blindness.not-blind-used-for-calibration: Not blind: these conditions were used for machine calibration on this computer ({id}).

blockIssueFix.BEAM_PROFILE_NOT_GAUSSIAN: The served model assumes a Gaussian beam; top-hat and ring beams are outside it.
blockIssueFix.BOUNDARY_NOT_ETCHED: Measure on an etched fusion boundary.
blockIssueFix.DATUM_NOT_ORIGINAL_SURFACE: Measure depth from the original plate surface, or state the datum you used.
blockIssueFix.INDEPENDENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: State whether these data were published before.
blockIssueFix.LOCATION_NEAR_ENDS_OR_UNSTATED: State the cross-section location; sections near track ends measure start or end transients.
blockIssueFix.LOSSES_ABOVE_20_PERCENT: More than 20 % of tracks or conditions were lost; measure more sections.
blockIssueFix.REDUCTION_UNUSABLE: Upload one row per track or per section, not a maximum or a single selected section.
blockIssueFix.SECTIONS_WITHOUT_TRACK: Add track_id so sections are grouped by track.
blockIssueFix.SURFACE_PREPARATION_UNSTATED: State how the plate surface was prepared.

wording.doNotResave: Do not open and save this file again before you upload it for scoring: saving it, even unchanged, in a spreadsheet program usually changes its bytes, and the hash will no longer match.
wording.notScoredAlloy: thresholds are registered for Ti-6Al-4V and AlSi10Mg only
wording.receiptLine: Predictions frozen. Values are withheld until you upload your measurements or choose to reveal them.
wording.relNote: rel is a fraction (pred - obs) / obs; positive means the model is deeper
wording.reportTitle: Your blind test on your own measurements
wording.researchReason: not requested: the P8 research route accepts requests only from the Research model panel today
wording.researchReview: Research arm: not requested in this version
wording.servedValueLabel: Unresolved: the served result does not yet list the source of each value.

status.descriptive-exposed: Not blind: {reason}. The statistics are shown for information.
status.inconclusive: Inconclusive: {reason}. The statistics are shown for information.
status.threshold-not-met: At least one threshold was not met on your data: {list}.
status.thresholds-met: All four thresholds were met on your data, with leverage and resolution met.
